core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghafir corresponds to the Arabic form غافر (Arabic root غ ف ر (gh-f-r); active participle غافِر (Ghāfir)). Its core sense is forgiving. Ghafir is Arabic غافر (Ghāfir) 'the forgiving one', the active participle of the root غ ف ر (gh-f-r) 'to forgive'; it is also a divine name and the title of Surah 40 (al-Ghāfir, 'The Forgiver'). The source gloss 'the one who forgives' is correct.
